files.Makefile:
load ./pressure.so
VALUE := initial
START := $(guile (begin (use-modules (ice-9 threads)) (call-with-new-thread (lambda () (let await () (unless (file-exists? "release") (usleep 2000) (await))) (gmk-eval "VALUE := worker") (let ((value (gmk-expand "$$(VALUE)"))) (call-with-output-file "done.tmp" (lambda (port) (display value port) (newline port))) (rename-file "done.tmp" "done")))) ""))

.PHONY: all gate
all: gate
	$(info final=$(VALUE))@:
gate:
	@$(fdpressure 64,reserve)./recipe 64 worker

load ./pressure.so
VALUE := initial
START := $(guile "initialized")

.PHONY: all gate
all: gate
	$(info final=$(VALUE))@:
gate:
	@$(fdpressure 64,exhaust)./recipe 64 plain
